Description 

 Data Engineer/Architect

Location: Remote

Clearance Required: US Citizenship; Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance

 

Leidos has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Engineer/Architect to support the design of a new data foundation. This foundation will support generative AI applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and enable analysis of diverse data sets. Looking for an engineer with strong architectural and hands-on development skills who can define the foundation (tools, schemas, and ontologies) and document that definition so that software engineers can implement, and management can understand the capabilities that the foundation can support. 

 

This role is open to candidates across a range of experience levels. The scope of the position and corresponding compensation will be aligned with the selected candidate’s background and expertise.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Design and implementation of big data systems, ETL pipelines and Data Lakes / Lakehouse / Meshes.Design and implementation of schema and ontologies.Design and implementation of data foundation to support generative AI applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and business analytics.Design and implementation of row/cell level data access control.Hands-on software development using Python and/or JavaScript to support data integration and application functionality.Documentation of data definitions and designs.
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ or 12+ years of experience in a Science, Engineering, or Technology field or a Master’s degree with 6+ or 10+ years of experience in a Science, Engineering, or Technology field. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.US citizenship; Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance in DISS.5+ years of experience with design and development of systems to analyze structured and unstructured large data sets from disparate sources.5+ years of experience with principals associated with AI applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).Ability to develop tools, algorithms and queries to improve business performance.Ability to develop new technical solutions, including hands-on Python or JavaScript development, to achieve project goals.Ability to develop intelligent systems that analyze data, learn from patterns, predict outcomes, and make informed decisions autonomously.Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to communicate data engineering and architectural concepts to non-technical audience.Experience working directly with product owners.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating and/or operating: Dagster, PostgresSQL, Alembic, pgvector Experience with digital Engineering (SysML).Experience with generative AI applications, including RAG, embeddings, and vector search.Experience with operational support to data foundation and devOps.Familiar with Medallion style architecture.Current Secret clearance in DISS.
 

Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.







POSITION SUMMARYCVS Health is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering to join the Enterprise Observability Platform organization and help advance the next generation of observability, infrastructure, and security data capabilities. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will play a critical role in designing, building, and operating scalable data pipelines and data products that power enterprise observability, operational intelligence, and security analytics across the organization. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and optimizing Databricks-based data engineering solutions that ingest, transform, govern, and deliver high-volume telemetry, infrastructure, application, and security data. This role combines deep hands-on technical execution with ownership of engineering excellence, operational reliability, performance optimization, and data platform best practices.


Working closely with Observability Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, and Data Platform teams, the Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will contribute to the evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by building resilient ingestion frameworks, establishing data quality standards, enhancing governance controls, and driving efficient, scalable data processing patterns. The ideal candidate is passionate about engineering high-quality solutions, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement, influencing technical standards, and raising the overall quality, reliability, and maintainability of the platform and team.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIESDesign, build, deploy, and support scalable Databricks-based data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that ingest, transform, and curate observability, infrastructure, and security data from multiple enterprise sources.Develop and optimize PySpark workloads, Structured Streaming jobs, and bronze/silver/gold data architectures while ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, data quality, and operational excellence.Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Observability, and Platform Engineering teams to onboard new data sources, establish governance standards, improve metadata management, and deliver trusted enterprise data products.Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, CI/CD practices, monitoring strategies, and platform optimization efforts while proactively identifying and addressing technical debt, process gaps, and operational risks.Support the ongoing evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by promoting best practices for Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, security controls, access management, and cost-efficient data platform operations.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS5+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise data engineering solutions using Python, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and distributed data processing technologies.5+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large-scale data pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, and bronze/silver/gold lakehouse architectures across multiple data sources.4+ years of experience working with Databricks in production environments, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, serverless SQL, performance optimization, and platform operations.3+ years of experience developing high-volume batch and streaming data solutions, implementing data quality controls, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.2+ years of experience collaborating with engineering teams, participating in code reviews, contributing to technical standards, applying cloud security and access management principles, and communicating technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONSExperience building Structured Streaming and near real-time ingestion solutions within Databricks or similar cloud-native data platforms.Experience implementing Databricks governance capabilities, including Unity Catalog, storage credentials, external locations, catalog management, and access control frameworks.Familiarity with OCSF or similar observability, cybersecurity, or security event normalization frameworks.Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for data engineering solutions using Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent automation frameworks.Prior experience supporting observability, infrastructure, cybersecurity, logging, telemetry, or operational analytics platforms in large-scale enterprise environments.

Data Engineer 4





Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 




Job Description:



Shield AI is seeking a Data Engineer to build the reliable, governed data foundation for Finance's next generation of planning and decision support. Working on our Databricks platform, you will own reusable integrations, semantic-layer infrastructure, and production data services that support analytics and AI-enabled applications. You will combine engineering rigor with AI-assisted development to increase delivery speed, reliability, and cost efficiency.




\n




What you'll do:

Build and operate scalable pipelines and integrations connecting enterprise data to Finance products.
Develop semantic-layer infrastructure and governed data access for analytics, planning, and AI applications.
Establish end-to-end pipeline observability, data-quality controls, and resilient operations.
Engineer the services and integrations behind Databricks Genie and other AI-enabled Finance workflows.
Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development while validating correctness, security, and performance.
Apply FinOps practices to manage platform spend and optimize cost without compromising service quality.
Partner with analytics engineers and enterprise teams on architecture, data contracts, and sustainable ownership.




Required qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical or quantitative field and a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
Hands-on production data engineering experience with SQL and Python or PySpark.
Experience with cloud data platforms, orchestration, data modeling, and governed serving patterns.
Ability to design for observability, recoverability, security, and maintainability.
Proficiency with AI coding assistants and independent validation of generated work.
Practical experience enabling AI capabilities on enterprise data, ideally in Databricks; adjacent Snowflake Cortex or comparable experience is welcome.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and production ownership.




Preferred qualifications:

Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, cloud infrastructure, and deployment automation.
Experience developing AI application backends, model integrations, or LLM-based workflows.
Experience with FinOps, financial data, or enterprise-system integrations.
